texts: Cafe in the Cave - Cappadocia, Turkey - Carved directly into ancient volcanic rock formations, this surreal coffee shop serves Turkish coffee brewed in sand using a method unchanged for centuries, with stalactites hanging above limestone tables.

Cafe D'Oaxaca - Oaxaca, Mexico - Hidden behind a unmarked door in a former cantina, this speakeasy-style shop serves exclusively indigenous Zapotec and Mixtec varieties, with the owner grinding each batch on a volcanic stone metate just as local farmers have done for generations.

The Coffee House at Keen's - New York City, USA - Built inside a preserved 19th-century blacksmith shop that once forged tools for the California Gold Rush, this Manhattan gem serves coffee in a converted walk-in pipe organ vault, where the original 1907 ventilation system still works.
